(i) guppies respond to the actions of others and maintain individual differences in their responses when interacting with either a live companion or with an open loop controlled biomimetic fish robot, and (ii) individual differences in social response towards a robot can be maintained over repeated testing, even though habituation is detectable.

(i) individual variation in social responses towards a robotic fish is maintained over multiple tests, and (ii) individual differences in responsiveness towards a robotic fish are maintained when interacting with both the robot and a live companion.

the responses of live animals towards biomimetic robots can be comparable to those of live animals, provided that the robot is designed to provide biologically relevant social information.
